name: Reyna E. Diaz
office: Duarte Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Reyna Diaz is the president of the Duarte Unified School District Board of Education. She was first elected in 1997.

sentences.text: Reyna Diaz is the president of the Duarte Unified School District Board of Education.

items.text: She serves on the California Department of Education Child Nutrition Advisory Council. In 2024, she supported a two-year contract agreement with the teachers union. She said the agreement "supports our teachers."
